mechanism: Pioglitazone may increase valproate levels through competitive protein binding displacement and potential inhibition of glucuronidation, while valproate may increase pioglitazone metabolism; additive metabolic and weight gain effects with thiazolidinediones.
action: Monitor blood glucose control and valproate serum levels; assess for signs of hyperglycemia and valproate toxicity; consider alternative antidiabetic agents if possible.
